bias.confirmation: Wait for one side to be swept; the reclaim and displacement define direction
bias.method: Monthly → weekly → daily → 4H → 1H narrative; Asia supplies the intraday manipulation map and 5m confirms execution.

asia.name: Asian range
asia.qualityNote: Compact accumulation range; suitable for watching a one-sided raid.

playbook.verdict: Bearish reversal candidate: ARH has been rejected after the buy-side raid.
steps: Liquidity condition: watch ARH resistance retest.
Confirmation: require a bearish 5m displacement and market-structure shift back through the range.
Distribution: use Asian low as the first objective, then the higher-timeframe draw.
Flip condition: reclaim ARH with bullish acceptance; then target higher external buy-side.
playbook.noTradeIf: Both Asian edges are swept, price never reclaims the raided edge, or high-impact news is imminent.
